UPON hearing the counsel 1) Against an order of rejection of regular bail by the High Court and to seek bail, the present special leave petition has been filed.

The petitioner is in custody w.e.f.
18.04.2022 in connection with FIR No.143/2021 dated 13.07.2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 354-C, 323, 406 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Section 354-C IPC deleted later on) and Section 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,

1 registered with Police Station Women NIT, District Faridabad.
2) After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the period of custody which is already four years and that the charges were framed on 10.08.2022 and by this time, 9 out of 20 witnesses have been examined

Considering all the attending circumstances, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we deem it appropriate to release the petitioner on bail.
3) Accordingly, we direct to release the petitioner on bail on furnishing the suitable bail bonds and sureties and on such other terms and conditions as may be deemed fit by the trial Court.
4) Petitioner to abide all the conditions as imposed and shall regularly attend the trial until exempted by the Court.
Violation, if any, may give a cause to take recourse as permissible and the trial Court is at liberty to do the needful.
5) Accordingly, and in view of the foregoing, the special leave petition stands allowed. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
